# How efficiently is your SaaS turning cash into growth?

> Free SaaS efficiency calculator: burn multiple, magic number, Rule of 40 and runway from your quarterly numbers, with benchmark bands and what it takes to reach a 1.5 burn multiple. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
